# Test-isolation allowlist — scripts/test-isolation-audit.sh
#
# Format:  <file>:<kind>:<literal>  # <reason>
# An entry with no reason is an error, not a pass: an allowlisted literal whose
# justification was never written down is indistinguishable from an oversight.
#
# The bar for an entry is ONE of:
#   inert       the literal is test DATA — a packet tuple, a /proc fixture, a
#               manifest string, a config default being asserted, a path handed
#               to a classifier. Nothing binds it and nothing creates it.
#   overridable the literal is an env-var default (`${FOO:-/tmp/bar}`), so the
#               harness can and does point concurrent runs elsewhere.
#   unique      the literal is a prefix completed at run time by $$, %d or a
#               nonce, so two runs cannot produce the same name.
#   in-container the address or path is resolved inside a container, not on the
#               host, so host-level concurrency does not reach it.
#
# "It happens to work today" is NOT a reason. If a test binds a port or creates
# a fixed path, fix it: free_port() from test/lib/freeport.bash, bind
# 127.0.0.1:0 and read the port back, $BATS_TEST_TMPDIR, or t.TempDir().
#
# Audit the list:  scripts/test-isolation-audit.sh --list-allowlisted

# --- bats ------------------------------------------------------------------

# The httpd command and its ports live inside a Pod spec in a heredoc manifest.
# Both the bind and the file are in the container's namespace, never the host's.
test/dual-cluster-networking.bats:PORT:8080  # in-container: busybox httpd inside a Pod spec, not a host bind
test/dual-cluster-networking.bats:PORT:30081  # inert: nodePort field in a Service manifest string
test/dual-cluster-networking.bats:TMP:/tmp/index.html  # in-container: written inside the echo Pod, not on the host

# ss/docker-ps output fixtures that drive the preflight gates into pass and fail.
# These are strings compared against, never sockets.
test/p2-dualcluster-preflight.bats:PORT:22  # inert: fixture line of fake `ss -tlnH` output
test/p2-dualcluster-preflight.bats:PORT:8081  # inert: fixture line of fake `docker ps` output
test/p2-dualcluster-preflight.bats:PORT:8082  # inert: fixture line of fake `ss -tlnH` output
test/p2-dualcluster-preflight.bats:PORT:34777  # inert: fixture collision the gate must detect; written to a fake ss file
test/p2-dualcluster-preflight.bats:PORT:34788  # inert: remaining use is the test NAME; the live binder now uses free_port()

# Docker-lab suite: the address is resolved by `docker exec ... bao`, i.e. inside
# the container. The host-side URL is taken from `docker port` instead.
test/spire-federation-openbao-jwt.bats:PORT:8200  # in-container: BAO_ADDR for `docker exec`, host port comes from `docker port`

# Expected stderr text from a fake kubectl, asserted as a string.
test/sldc-ingest-bearer.bats:PORT:6443  # inert: fake kubectl's connection-refused message, compared as text

# Go cache/module/path defaults. Every one is `${VAR:-/tmp/...}`, and
# scripts/parallel-acceptance.sh sets GOCACHE/GOMODCACHE/GOPATH per run so the
# two runs never share. Go's build cache is lock-protected in any case.
test/sltm-probe-apikey.bats:TMP:/tmp/go  # overridable: ${GOPATH:-/tmp/go}
test/sltm-probe-apikey.bats:TMP:/tmp/go-cache  # overridable: ${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-cache}
test/sltm-probe-apikey.bats:TMP:/tmp/gomodcache  # overridable: ${GOMODCACHE:-/tmp/gomodcache}
test/signal-ingest-image-tag.bats:TMP:/tmp/gocache  # overridable: ${GOCACHE:-/tmp/gocache}
test/signal-ingest-image-tag.bats:TMP:/tmp/gomodcache  # overridable: ${GOMODCACHE:-/tmp/gomodcache}
test/signal-ingest-image-tag.bats:TMP:/tmp/gopath  # overridable: ${GOPATH:-/tmp/gopath}
test/tombstone-mutation-check.bats:TMP:/tmp/gocache  # overridable: ${GOCACHE:-/tmp/gocache}
test/tombstone-mutation-check.bats:TMP:/tmp/gomodcache  # overridable: ${GOMODCACHE:-/tmp/gomodcache}
test/sltm-ingest-reload-ratelimit.bats:TMP:/tmp/go  # overridable: ${GOPATH:-/tmp/go}
test/sltm-ingest-reload-ratelimit.bats:TMP:/tmp/go-cache  # overridable: ${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-cache}
test/sltm-ingest-reload-ratelimit.bats:TMP:/tmp/gomodcache  # overridable: ${GOMODCACHE:-/tmp/gomodcache}
test/sltm-ingest-chain.bats:TMP:/tmp/go  # overridable: ${GOPATH:-/tmp/go}
test/sltm-ingest-chain.bats:TMP:/tmp/go-cache  # overridable: ${GOCACHE:-/tmp/go-cache}
test/sltm-ingest-chain.bats:TMP:/tmp/gomodcache  # overridable: ${GOMODCACHE:-/tmp/gomodcache}
